title: Chapter 467
paragraphs: Chapter 467
132. Massacre, and strange...(1)
- An aura? You want to use me as an aura?
- Yes. When we go to the Gaipa Military Road, all four major factions will be gathered. Prominent figures will be there as representatives.
- So, you don't want to lose ground among them, that's what you're saying.
- Right. We also need to be prepared for any possible situations.
- Well, I can do that.
- Anyway, so you're going? After helping Gilly, I'll have various lines prepared for you to use according to the situations on the Gaipa Military Road.
- Lines? What kind of lines?
- Yes, that kind of thing.
A conversation just before departing from Tichan to Gaipa Military Road.
The reason for preparing the lines in advance was none other than:
It was thought that this gathering of the four major factions competing against each other would be the perfect place to create appropriate rumors.
Rumors about the 12th generation and his guardian dragon, who already have tremendous power and are as good as being connected to Rune Kandel's throne.
The need for an aura wasn't just to consider Murakan's mood.
Murakan had all the elements. Legitimacy and symbolism as the guardian deity of Rune Kandel, an unprecedented dominance that no one could follow, and the uniqueness of being a black dragon.
The only thing missing for Murakan now was 'current dignity.'
However, even that had unintentionally gained fame due to the 'Black King Incident' not long ago, so it was necessary to continue that momentum properly.
With a few more displays of power, Murakan would become a more radiant aura than anyone else, and Jin was extremely satisfied with how things had turned out.

'Although the situation was somewhat different from what I expected due to Amela already battling the four major factions and the wildfire unintentionally becoming a joint ceremony, it's even better. I can't imagine a better situation.'

Just like during the Black King Incident, it was perfect for spreading exaggerated rumors. Jin was suddenly proud of the time he had spent thinking about lines to use while holding onto the black dragon who didn't listen to him.
'Line 3?'
Murakan asked with a gesture.
'Yes, line 3!'
Jin showed three fingers and put strength into his eyes, and Murakan nodded vigorously as if he understood perfectly.
Then, in a majestic tone and low voice, he said:
[Insignificant humans, do you... desire power...?]
As soon as Murakan opened his mouth, Jin couldn't help but grab the back of his neck after a long time.
That was line 33, not line 3.
'Murakan, not line 33, but line 3, line 3!'
Line 33 was meant to be used when the enemies clearly surrender and swear loyalty. Obviously, it didn't fit the current situation at all.
Whoosh, Kurarararak!
Now, the wildfire had reached its peak, igniting the last blaze fiercely.
The black tidal wave of destruction ravaged humans, objects, and nature alike, while the desperate cries of those trying to survive reached a peak.
Thus, Murakan's mistake was buried in the indescribably noisy uproar. It was a great relief that the 33rd line was not the type to be shouted out loud.
'It seems that fortunately, no one heard it.'
Making nonsense remarks that didn't fit the situation would only tarnish his dignity.
He sighed with relief. Murakan seemed to realize that something was wrong as he tilted his head.
Murakan looked again at Jin's three fingers. Soon, he realized his mistake and opened his mouth again.
"From this moment on, this place, Kaifa Gundo, is the land of Murakan."
In contrast to the majestic and low voice, this time it was a dignified and far-reaching, powerful voice.
Everyone could clearly hear Murakan's voice amidst the terrible chaos.
'My land? Did he, by any chance, kill the youngest, the mercenary Amela?'
As Vugo, there was no other way to understand it.
If Amela had merely been "subdued," they should have shown the severely injured Amela herself, or at least her corpse.
'As expected, Amela was defeated by the 12th generation and Murakan!'
Ratz also made such a judgment.

He also thought that if he were Jin, he would have killed Amela. If Amela does not express loyalty like the Ghost Army or the Black King Party, keeping her alive would only make her an enemy belonging to another force.
Once affiliated with another major force, no one can touch Amela easily. In Ratz's view, now was the best time for Jin to "kill without burden" Amela.
'Also, it is the best time to kill all the witnesses...!'
A terrifying future flashed through Ratz's mind for a moment.
What if only Jin, Murakan, and the knights of Runecandle, including Vugo, survive in Kaifa Gundo, and everyone else dies?
Then, how Amela made her choice, what kind of death she faced, and how the four major forces that went to find her ended.
Even if Runecandle appoints knights as they please, other forces would have no means to refute. If there is not a single witness who watched the battle in Kaifa Gundo.
'I don't know about other Runecandles, but the 12th generation is particularly skilled at public relations. I must prevent that from happening!'
In other words, he must survive. Somehow, he had to survive and report everything he saw and experienced today to the Emperor.
"And you have invaded my land, so not a single one of you shall survive."
As Murakan finished the third line, Ratz gritted his teeth, and Jin sighed in relief.
Every single person will be killed without exception.
Although the meaning of the third line was exactly that, in fact, Jin did not intend to kill everyone without exception.
For the rumor to roll properly, a few people must survive and return.
"However, we absolutely cannot let someone like Midor Elner live."
Excluding the Runcandels, the remaining five people from each camp were not of the utmost importance. That was the extent of the mercy Jin was willing to offer.
The black wave was fading. The upheaval was coming to an end.
Eventually, when the energy of the upheaval had completely cleared, the landscape on the ground was a desolate scene of ash and death.
No groans or screams were heard. There were no sounds of people painfully groaning while leaning on something.
All that could be heard was the sound of burning corpses with lingering flames and the panting breaths of the survivors.
It was as if there were no injured people left. Those who couldn't endure it all died.
"Line 6."
As Jin signaled a new line, Murakan looked down at the ground.
"Ah, I didn't know there would be so many bugs that wouldn't die just from being stepped on. Quite unpleasant."
Line 6 wasn't just about the words.
Whoosh!
As soon as the line ended, Murakan unleashed a black breath. It was aimed at Kinzel, and one of the top warriors of the Baekrang Tribe was hit by it and died instantly.
Murakan's power had reached 50%, and everyone had exhausted their energy trying to prevent the upheaval, so they couldn't respond.
Of course, even considering those factors, there weren't many beings in the world that could easily defeat the top warrior of the Baekrang Tribe.
"Eek!"
The lucky surviving enemy king retreated in fear. He was terrified once more after seeing only the ankle of the recently deceased top Baekrang warrior left on the ground.
Now, even the Baekrangs, not just the enemy tribe, seemed to struggle to suppress their fear.
Gulp...!
The other onlookers unconsciously swallowed their saliva repeatedly.
"Line 7."
At Jin's signal, Murakan turned his head towards Vugo and the Runcandels.

"Runcandel, you should leave the island quickly and return to your family. And tell Rosa Runcandel. I will question her about sending the family's knights to my land without permission. There must be a proper explanation."
The eyes of Vugo and the guardian knights widened. They couldn't believe their ears.

"No, he just said that from this moment on, the Gaipa Province became his land. He's going to question my mother for sending us to his land without permission? We arrived first, what kind of nonsense is this?"
As Vugo thought, Murakan's words were inconsistent. Moreover, it was a statement that clearly disregarded the acting head of the family.
However, Vugo couldn't argue.
He didn't know what might happen if he confronted Murakan in this situation. Besides, if he confronted Murakan, the situation could only get ridiculous.
"…Understood, Lord Murakan. I will convey the message. But, may I ask you a question?"
Slyly, Murakan lowered his gaze to look at Jin. Jin nodded in agreement.
"I allow it, Vugo Runcandel."
"What happened to the mercenary Amela?"
Jin made a throat-slitting gesture to Murakan, who once again lowered his gaze.
"I killed her."
Everyone had expected as much. However, when Murakan himself said it, their hearts felt empty with a sense of loss.
They had rushed to capture Amela, but there had been too many losses.
Moreover, she was killed by an unexpected black dragon, who was now threatening to kill them all.
At least none of the Runcandels had died, and it wasn't too bad since it was just Vugo and his knights who had gone through a lot of trouble.
"On your way back, if you look carefully at the sea ahead, you might find the ashes of that stupid mercenary."
"…Thank you for letting us know, Lord Murakan."
"Be on your way."
"Lord Murakan, could you give us another chance?"
As Vugo said one more thing, Murakan furrowed his brow.
"What are you talking about all of a sudden?"

"The royal family and Kinzelos will not be a problem for you to slaughter, Lord Murakan. However, soon reinforcements will come from the Tower of Magic. This is because there is a tower master here. We will help you."
The tower master's staff.
As a Runcandel rider, Vugo knew about the staff of the tower master who had once driven Jin into a crisis in Colon.
The function that could summon the main force in an emergency.
Jin shook his head, trying to make the most imposing expression he could, and Murakan responded with the most vicious look he could muster.
"Vugo Runcandel, you seem to think very little of me, Murakan. You and your little bunch will help me? Just to deal with something like the main force of Zifel?"
"Lord Murakan, I have no other intention…"
"If you say one more thing, I'll kill all of you. Get lost…"
"I didn't call for it!"
Suddenly, someone cut off Murakan's words with a clear voice.
It was Sandra Zifel. The attention of everyone, including Murakan, was focused on her.
"I didn't activate the Tower Master's staff. So, oh great black dragon, why don't you stop playing puppeteer? The hidden puppet master, Jin Runcandel. Why don't you come forward?"
I've always wanted to meet you.
Sandra continued with a sly smile.
